Hi everyone,

The new update for Aurora Nights is out now.

- New start screen pictures
- Most typos in English version should be fixed now
- Steam Store page rehaul
- New in-game text font
- New 3rd party licenses file added
- Additional minor bugfixes

Join our Discord for more news and updates!

Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.title: Aurora Nights Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24698112/510d8f11192978ee9887423ad67758969180f889.jpg

Greetings!

First of all, thank you for the amazing support you've given the game! I didn't expect such overwhelming response, and I am glad that you liked the game so much!

As a reminder, there was an update which went live the day after the release.

Patch v1.01 Notes

 Volume of clicking sound has been decreased;
 Added support for custom fullscreen resolution;
 Fixed aspect ratio in window mode;
 Added support for playing menu music during gameplay.

If you want to turn on any hidden custom option, please refer to the instruction here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/466870/discussions/0/357287304420406590/

Enjoy the game! ːarrstarː
